claim: On current source, an established camp's advertised native Gather Materials companion mission can return materials to the current camp's first native Storage destination, with a fresh exact pre/post item-state observation.
material_proof: A selected current-source run records current camp identity and the first native Storage destination's exact center, top-level item type/count, and owner as setup-state; it then retains accepted native board, worker-choice, Gather Materials departure, native elapsed-time, matching recovery, and return receipts. A post-return view of that same destination shows a changed item state and the returned worker's authoritative state, followed by accepted cleanup.
material_contradiction: Storage zone, destination center, item state, or ownership is inferred rather than observed in the current native run
fixture zones or material are credited as a gather placement
a selected worker is not actually sent on the advertised Gather Materials mission
recovery occurs before native time reaches the mission's return condition, differs from the started mission, or fails to return that worker
the exact first-Storage pre/post state does not change after return
a random native mission failure is rerolled without an independently changed, informative setup
a physical key, OCR, coordinate, callback, direct state/save mutation, or synthetic receipt is used
already_accepted_evidence: R-032 separately established a camp identity, worker assignment, Food accounting, Survey Expansion return, Locker behavior, and a Patrol priority-zero release contradiction.
Prepared-fixture transforms provide only zero-credit Food/Storage footing and supplied food.
current_uncertainty: The current Gather Materials availability, worker choice, departure, return timing, random result, first Storage destination, post-return contents, and ownership must be observed rather than inferred. A native no-result or failed return bounds this fresh run without settling unrelated camp behavior.
forbidden_shortcuts: physical keys, hotkeys, OCR, screenshots, coordinates, or guessed controls
direct NPC, camp, mission, item, zone, or save mutation after fixture install
crediting fixture installation, zones, supplied food, startup, board opening, or semantic acceptance without the named return and changed Storage state
rerolling a random result by restaging the same fixture
honest_stop_conditions: stop before launch if no active source-matched registry selection exists
after launch, preserve unavailable Gather Materials, native failure, missing Storage observation, or unchanged Storage state as a bounded result
seal proof only after departure, native elapsed-time readiness, matching return, changed exact Storage state, post-return worker state, and cleanup are cited
